card.text: A fast-spinning Be star eight times the Sun's width, with a companion on a seven-year orbit.

sources.label: Kervella et al. (2022), Astronomy & Astrophysics 667 A111

introduction.text: VLT and VLTI followed its companion for 13 years: the orbit weighs Achernar at 5.99 solar masses, with 15,539 K at its surface.
